POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL superuser username. Referenced by langfuse-web and langfuse-worker as ${{postgres.POSTGRES_USER}}.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL superuser password. Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced in DATABASE_URL as ${{POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database name. Langfuse uses this database for all its data.

POSTGRES_PORT.description: Port PostgreSQL listens on inside the container. Must stay 5432.

PGDATA.description: Data directory inside the volume. Points below the mount root to avoid the lost+found conflict.

DATABASE_URL.description: Self-referencing connection string. Consumed by the postgres service itself and referenced by Langfuse as ${{postgres.DATABASE_URL}}.

REDIS_AUTH.description: Redis password (requirepass). Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by langfuse-web and langfuse-worker as ${{redis.REDIS_AUTH}}.

REDIS_PORT.description: Redis server listening port. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{redis.REDIS_PORT}}.

REDIS_HOST.description: Redis internal hostname. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{redis.REDIS_HOST}}.

CLICKHOUSE_DB.description: Default ClickHouse database. Langfuse uses this for analytics data. Referenced as ${{clickhouse.CLICKHOUSE_DB}}.

CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: ClickHouse username. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{clickhouse.CLICKHOUSE_USER}}.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: ClickHouse password. Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{clickhouse.CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD}}.

CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT.description: Allow the default user to manage access control so Langfuse can create its tables.

MINIO_ROOT_USER.description: MinIO root username. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{minio.MINIO_ROOT_USER}}.

MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: MinIO root password. Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by Langfuse as ${{minio.MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}}.

PORT.description: HTTP port Langfuse web listens on.

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Public URL of this Langfuse deployment. Auto-resolves so OAuth callbacks and email links work out of the box.

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Cryptographic key used to sign session cookies and JWTs. Auto-generated 64-char hex at deploy time.

SALT.description: Salt used for hashing API keys. Auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by langfuse-worker.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 64-character hex key encrypting sensitive data at rest. Must be 256 bits. Referenced by langfuse-worker.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string, companion-referenced to the postgres service DATABASE_URL.

CLICKHOUSE_URL.description: ClickHouse HTTP endpoint, wired to the companion ClickHouse service.

CLICKHOUSE_USER.description: ClickHouse username, matching the companion service.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: ClickHouse password — companion-referenced so consumer and producer always match.

CLICKHOUSE_MIGRATION_URL.description: ClickHouse native-protocol URL used by migrations. Companion-referenced, no literals.

CLICKHOUSE_CLUSTER_ENABLED.description: Single-node ClickHouse: disable cluster migrations so no ZooKeeper/Keeper is required.

REDIS_HOST.description: Redis hostname, wired to the companion Redis service.

REDIS_AUTH.description: Redis password — companion-referenced so consumer and producer always match.

LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: MinIO access key for event uploads — companion-referenced.

LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_SECRET_ACCESS_K.description: MinIO secret key for event uploads — companion-referenced.

LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT.description: Internal MinIO endpoint used by the server for event uploads.

LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_REGION.description: S3 region for event uploads (MinIO expects "auto").

LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_FORCE_PATH_STYL.description: Use path-style S3 URLs (required for MinIO).

LANGFUSE_S3_EVENT_UPLOAD_PREFIX.description: Key prefix for event upload objects.

LANGFUSE_S3_MEDIA_UPLOAD_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: MinIO access key for media uploads — companion-referenced.

LANGFUSE_S3_MEDIA_UPLOAD_SECRET_ACCESS_K.description: MinIO secret key for media uploads — companion-referenced.

LANGFUSE_S3_MEDIA_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT.description: PUBLIC MinIO endpoint used by browsers for presigned media uploads.

LANGFUSE_S3_MEDIA_UPLOAD_REGION.description: S3 region for media uploads (MinIO expects "auto").

LANGFUSE_S3_MEDIA_UPLOAD_FORCE_PATH_STYL.description: Use path-style S3 URLs (required for MinIO).

LANGFUSE_S3_MEDIA_UPLOAD_PREFIX.description: Key prefix for media upload objects.

TELEMETRY_ENABLED.description: Anonymous usage telemetry. Disabled by default in this template.
